description: This file defines a move-only function wrapper similar to std::move_only_function, with fallback implementation if the standard library does not support it. It includes internal handling for small object optimization, type erasure, and invocation mechanics, and is used within the uWebSockets project as uWS::MoveOnlyFunction.

classes.name: any_invocable
classes.description: A move-only, type-erased callable wrapper similar to std::move_only_function, supporting small object optimization and various invocation semantics.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Invokes the stored callable with provided arguments.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Swaps the contents with another instance.
